verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM itself lets users chat with their documents through RAG, turning every document into the agent's knowledge base. It also auto-summarizes meetings into action items and key decisions. A hands-on user reported largely correct answers over regulatory PDFs but garbled citations. Insights come mainly from user-initiated Q&A and meeting summaries, and there is no documented proactive insight or suggestion generation across general data. Missing for 10: documented proactive insights and suggestions over user data beyond chat Q&A and meeting summaries, in-depth first-party docs on the insight features, and reliable citation and grounding quality (citations reported as garbled).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Chat with your docs, use AI Agents
Every document becomes part of your agent's knowledge base
Action items, key decisions, and full transcripts ready the moment you hang up.
answers were largely correct, but the citations window showed somewhat garbled content
